visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit gym filled with black and silver weight machines, a muscular man with blonde dyed hair, wearing a dark green sweatshirt and grey pants, approaches another man with thick curly black hair performing triceps pushdowns. The muscular man gestures with his hand as if asking a question, while the other man continues his exercise with a focused, almost annoyed expression. (2) Close-up shot of the muscular man's face, displaying a confused or slightly hurt expression. He looks down as yellow text appears at the top and bottom of the frame. The background shows gym racks out of focus. (3) The scene transitions to a white-tiled bathroom. The curly-haired man is drying his hair with a white blowdryer in front of a mirror. The muscular man tries to walk past him through a narrow doorway. Both characters exhibit frustration through their facial expressions and hand movements. (4) The curly-haired man exits the frame. The muscular man is left alone in the very narrow bathroom space. He flexes slightly and looks at himself in the mirror, but as he tries to turn around and leave, his large shoulders and arms visibly hit the doorframe and the wall, showing him struggling to fit.
